bio: Hello! I'm Kathy Rayna! I'm a Raccoon themed tomboy Virtual Streamer! I enjoy entertaining others and making people smile! I like playing videogames, chill in VRChat and spending time with friends! I hope you can stop by and if so inclined join the Raccoon Nation!
